And the endless "negative emotions" of humankind... strife, hatred, greed...
...all flowed into the rift between universes, a place that is nowhere at all...
In time, they gathered in one place, fused together, and came to possess a single "will."
A will...?

Until I filled the entire rift between universes.
...And so, having gained immense power, I next resolved to intervene in your worlds.

notes.note: 0736.bla second Pt_Chara_Check chain (index -> R2/R6): Zero, OOO, 00, Mebius, W, Wing Zero, Taro, Den-O, God Gundam, Seven, Black RX, Zeta, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu. TextIdOffset+0+R plays #1-15, so #8-15 = Den-O, God Gundam, Seven, Black RX, Zeta, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu. Speaker is the first party slot filled in that chain order (slot 1 or 2), not strictly the leader. Same English as story_171 #1-7.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36) confirmed; #18-20 Regis (228), #21 Ankh confirmed. Extracted labels correct.
Regis echoes Ankh's 'where are you' and answers that it has been all around them since they woke in this world.

TextIdOffset+21+R: #22 Zero, #23 OOO, #24 00, #25 Mebius, #26 W, #27 Wing Zero, #28 Taro, #29 Den-O, #30 God Gundam, #31 Seven, #32 Black RX, #33 Zeta, #34 Ultraman, #35 Rider 1, #36 Nu. Three wordings: standard (most), casual 'so... is' (OOO #23, W #26), rough 'you're tellin' me' (Momotaros #29). Extracted '?party' on #22 = Zero (it is the generic wording, not Zero-specific).
Regis (228) confirmed. Singular 'Lost Hero' address rendered plural: the whole party is addressed, matching earlier 'you Lost Heroes' lines.
TextIdOffset+38+R, same chain: #46 = Den-O (Momotaros), who uses the coarse 'you' pronoun -> 'ya'. Everything else identical.
Regis monologue #54-57 (one sentence over #54-56). Quoted terms kept in double quotes as in source corner brackets. 'Rift between universes' for the space-between of the cosmos, used again at #77.

SCRIPT: MessWinSet(TextIdOffset+59) is a CONSTANT here (no +R), with CharaNameIn(CHARA_NAME[slot-1 character]). So only #60 ever plays, spoken by the first party member in chain order; #61-74 are never played. Extracted label 'Nu Gundam' is an artefact of the approximate trace (last value loaded into the slot register). All 15 identical, translated identically.
Regis #76-81 confirmed (+75..+80). #80-81 one sentence split across rows ('...and I made use of'), cut at the matching point.
MS rendered 'mobile suits' for clarity; kaiju/kaijin kept as elsewhere in the script.

TextIdOffset+81+R (slot 2 uses R6, slot 1 R2), same chain: #82 Zero, #83 OOO, #84 00, #85 Mebius, #86 W, #87 Wing Zero, #88 Taro, #89 Den-O, #90 God Gundam; block continues into story_173 (#91-96). All identical. Regis's reply (#97, story_173): all were under its control at a subconscious level.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0736.bla (second Pt_Chara_Check chain order for all party blocks). #60 is a constant MessWinSet (+59) so #61-74 never play; extracted 'Nu Gundam' label on #60 is wrong (it is the first party slot character). No new names or terms.
